svg.text: Baseline / Skill Assessment — scoped policies, frozen papers and exact evidence
Selected physical columns / workspace source 2026-11-23. Not a live schema capture.
selection_id: uuid NULLABLE for independent context
outcome_codes: jsonb legacy; new arrays empty
Physical FK map — parent → referencing child (composite owner keys summarized)
F1 assessment_rule_policy_version → assessment_rule_scoped_activation: same org purpose scope policy FK
F2 assessment_item_knowledge_mapping → assessment_item_skill_scope: append-only version binding V63
F4 rule_assessment_group → rule_assessment_item: composite group FK
F5 assessment_item_knowledge_mapping → rule_assessment_item: exact immutable mapping FK
F6 rule_assessment_item → rule_assessment_answer: presented item FK
F8 rule_assessment_group → skill_knowledge_review: failed prerequisite FK
F9 skill_knowledge_evidence → skill_knowledge_review: resolving evidence FK
F10 assessment_rule_policy_version → rule_assessment_attempt: exact org purpose policy FK
F11 assessment_rule_policy_version → assessment_rule_policy_version_number_history: same org purpose scope FK
Org/actor ownership and omitted identity/bank FKs remain in workspace migrations; this is a selected view, not the whole database.
New Skill policies: explicit mandatoryCount; exactly quota mandatory + remaining ordinary. Baseline mandatory/veto conditions are disabled.
Legacy null quota / OC columns remain readable. V63 item→Skill-version binding is append-only; no reinterpretation of frozen papers.
Official evidence accepts only genuine module-assessment/certificate sources; baseline and bypass do not award achievement.

g.text: Baseline: Role policy; selected Level chooses groups. Skill: Expert draft/history, Role activation.
Skill policy pointers are separate per Role; Role identity stays in frozen context JSON, not a new column.
V71 independent context: selection_id NULL, selection_revision 0. V72 preserves learner-account ownership.
V73 validates owned predecessors and shared Skill scope; counts/history/wait remain shared across Roles.
